outcome: Umbilical cord histological changes (intima-media layers, intima-media areas)
cohort: The study included umbilical cords from six neonates born to type 1 diabetic mothers and six control neonates.
finding: Maternal type 1 diabetes was associated with differential expression of 286 genes in umbilical cords, particularly those involved in vascular development and function, and with histological changes including thicker intima-media layers in umbilical vessels.
